issues.description: The section promises that technical details are covered in other parts of the guide but does not point the reader to specific sections. Readers (teachers) would benefit from explicit cross-references to the relevant technical subsections (e.g. where tokens/embeddings/training data are explained) and to where sample prompts (Copilot examples) are located.
issues.required_fix: Add explicit cross-references to the relevant sections in the manual (for example: 1.1.3 'Klíčové pojmy: tokens, embeddings, training data', 4.2.2.1 'Generování písemek pomocí Microsoft 365 Copilot ve Forms', and the Prompt Library in 9.1).

issues.description: The section references Copilot usage and a short workflow 'vygeneruj písemku' but contains no concrete example prompt or worked example. The Context memory notes this as an open thread.
issues.required_fix: Include at least one short example prompt for Microsoft 365 Copilot (or link directly to the existing example in 4.2.2.1) and add a brief worked example or a sample 'vygeneruj písemku' prompt in the text or as a footnote/reference to the Prompt Library (9.1).

issues.description: The quick checklist for pilot use is practical but could explicitly mention verifying accuracy, pedagogical suitability, academic integrity, and privacy/GDPR considerations when preparing AI-generated materials.
issues.required_fix: Expand the checklist to explicitly include: (a) verify factual accuracy and sources; (b) check pedagogical suitability and alignment with learning outcomes; (c) assess academic integrity risks and required student guidance; and (d) review privacy/GDPR implications for any student data used.
